summary_md: **Anemll ([@anemll](https://x.com/anemll/status/2115867579147559383))** discusses NVIDIA's paper on **Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B** ([arXiv 2610.33039](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.33039)), a hybrid Mamba-Transformer cut down from Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B-A12B with 26B tokens of 2-bit quantization-aware distillation so it fits in 24GB, shipping a speculative drafter (84 tok/s), and shares his own failed attempts at good 2-bit quality without big compute.

referenced_urls.title: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB: A Hybrid Vision-Language Model for Local AI

relevance: 2-bit QAD derived from Nemotron Super is directly relevant to DGX Spark models.
